Wärtsilä Portals

Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy

Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and financially viable.

Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

Wärtsilä in energy

Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient. One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof solutions.

Wärtsilä in marine

Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value with our customers and partners.

Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy Storage System installed earlier.

GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and scaling renewable integration.

Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic Sea region.

United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered by Wärtsilä engines.

Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and Hawaii.

Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the next step on their decarbonisation journey.
